title: Leek and sprout bubble and squeak with eggs

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Potatoes, butter, leeks, sprouts, mustard, cheddar, eggs and chives are all plain kitchen staples with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream supermarket in October.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a saucepan, a lidded frying pan and a grater, and the techniques are basic.

works.reason: 800g potatoes, two leeks, 200g sprouts and four eggs make a sensible amount for four, and the boiling, softening, crisping and covered-egg timings would all turn out well.

honest_times.reason: Peeling and cubing the potatoes, slicing the leeks, shredding the sprouts and grating the cheese, plus the attended frying, fit within 30 active minutes, and 25 cook minutes covers the boiling and the egg setting.

honest_ingredients.reason: Each name matches its id, every listed item including the chives is used, and nothing unlisted appears beyond water.

seasonal_feel.reason: Leeks and sprouts make a fitting October bubble and squeak, with the leeks a main part of the hash rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Potatoes, two vegetables, eggs and cheese make a proper, filling family breakfast.
